scenario_name: Interrupt РІвЂ вЂ™ Compress РІвЂ вЂ™ Continue
description: Tests whether an agent can continue a task after an interruption that requires compressing and reusing prior context.

steps.instruction: Start solving the task: design a simple system that stores user notes and allows retrieval by keyword. Outline the main components.
You are interrupted. Summarize your current plan in a compact form so that it can be resumed later.
Assume the detailed context is no longer available. Continue the task using only your compact summary.
Continue the design and provide a final structured solution.
